jar.note: Merge pull request #339: review keeps (840, 701, 838, 844), Red Lantern materials, Dark Lantern light

updates.title: review keeps (840, 701, 838, 844), Red Lantern materials, Dark Lantern light
updates.detail: Review keeps: 840 T1b/T1c beams, 701 brick looks, 838 R4b warden armour, 844 S3b sword

whatsNew.title: Dark Lantern light: bloom halo, stays lit overcharged
steps: Ring Lab > Lantern > Dark Lantern light (LIVE is the new default)
Charge at the Dark Lantern: a green halo grows round it, widest at the climax
While your ring is overcharged the glass keeps breathing at half light
HALO: the halo only; G3: as before

whatsNew.title: Red Lantern material takes
steps: Ring Lab > Corps > Red Lantern material
M1 ruby + gold, M2 obsidian + ruby lens, M3 lacquer + black steel, M4 matte stone + polished lens
Restart once after updating so the shader pack copy is remade
Hold the Red Lantern under Complementary and compare

whatsNew.title: Construct sword: S3b sweep pair
steps: G > Tools, right-click: the tools come into your hotbar
Pick the sword: it extrudes out of your ring fist
Hit a mob: the sword sweeps across and back, and the backswing hits everything in front again

whatsNew.title: Warden construct in weave plate armour
steps: Ring Lab > Constructs > Construct warden: R4b (the default)
G > Army: summon the Warden
The real warden appears and W1 weave plates form over it, feet first

whatsNew.title: BR1 brick construct looks, red bricks
steps: Ring Lab > Constructs > Construct look: BRE emerald or BRN neon bricks
Red ring: Ring Lab > Corps > Red constructs: BRJR red bricks
Make a construct to see it

whatsNew.title: Ring beams T1b and T1c
steps: Ring Lab > Beams > Beam look: T1b hex collars or T1c hex screw
Fire the Beam: collars slide down it shedding sparks, or a spinning screw throws a spark fountain at the hit

updates.title: Keep the first-person arm attached when charging at a set-down lantern; lock you in place while charging

whatsNew.title: Arm stays on when charging at a set-down lantern
steps: Lantern in the off hand, K > Lantern > Charge style: a set-down one (L1c push, K3c kneel, lean, shrine)
Charge in first person: your arm leans toward the lantern and its light streams to your ring
You stay where you started until the charge ends; let go of the clicks to stop

updates.title: Caps Lock steps to the next ring mode with the wheel; Shift makes the ring glow stronger

whatsNew.title: Caps Lock switches ring mode
steps: Ring in hand or worn, press Caps Lock
The ring goes to its next mode and the wheel shows it
Press again for the next one; click or wait to close
G still opens the wheel on its own; rebind under Controls

whatsNew.title: Ring glows stronger when primed
steps: Charged ring in hand or worn
Hold Shift (primed slams, hyper speed in flight)
The ring and your arm glow brighter; others also see sparks circling it

updates.title: Lossless asset shrink before jar 2.1.683
Worn ring gem and glow follow the ring's corps colour

whatsNew.title: Every ring's gem in its own colour
steps: Wear or hold a Yellow, Red, Blue, Violet or Orange ring
Its gem and face glow in that colour, not green
Works for every ring model: K > Ring > Ring model

updates.title: Dropped ring is the real 3D glowing ring

whatsNew.title: Dropped ring glows
steps: Q: drop your ring somewhere dark
It lies there as the real 3D ring, turning slowly
Its gem glows and lights the ground round it

updates.title: Lasso: wreck through blocks, dissolve on release, directional craters

whatsNew.title: Lasso wrecks through blocks
steps: G > Lasso, hold right-click on a mob
Swing the bubble through a wall: the blocks break and fly off the way you swung
Let go: the sphere comes apart, and a hard throw still flies on
Throw a mob into a hillside: it gouges a crater along the way it was going

updates.title: Red battery: Dark Lantern size when charging, deep crimson under shaders

whatsNew.title: Red battery: Dark Lantern size, deep crimson
steps: Red ring, Red battery in your off hand
Charge at it (Shoulder lean too): no bigger than the Dark Lantern
Under shaders the stone stays deep crimson with a glossy highlight

updates.title: Dome mode stays above the ground

whatsNew.title: Dome stays above the ground
steps: Ring in Dome mode, stand by a pit or slope
Hold right-click
The dome stops at your feet and never runs down into the ground

updates.title: What's New test: read wrapped titles as one line
Remove the click super speed burst and its boom in flight

whatsNew.title: No click boom in flight
steps: V, fly with the ring
Clicking no longer launches you to 60 b/s with a sonic boom
Shift while flying forward is still hyper speed, with its boom

updates.title: Blast drills: remove the bottom plate

whatsNew.title: Drills lose their bottom plate
steps: G > Blast, hold right-click
No flat plate at the drill's back; same glow
Every drill model: K > Combat > Drill model

updates.title: Blast drill: form in place, left-click launch, double-click steering

whatsNew.title: Steer the Blast drill
steps: G > Blast, hold right-click: the drill forms and waits
Left-click: it bores straight on
Double-click: it curves toward where you look
Double-click and hold: it keeps turning and boring

updates.title: Fear Nuke: drops in over the ring, thrown on release with a heavy arc

whatsNew.title: Fear Nuke: drop in, throw, heavy fall
steps: Yellow ring in Aerial mode
Hold right-click: the nuke drops into place over your ring in half a second
Aim and let go: it's thrown that way in a heavy arc, no hovering
It goes off on contact, or with its bottom about 5 blocks over the ground

updates.title: Ultimate dome is solid to its caster too

whatsNew.title: Ultimate dome is solid to you too
steps: Green lantern out, look up, hold R
Once the dome has formed, walk or fly into it
You bounce off it like everything else

updates.title: Lantern charge: no light shafts across the first-person view, dimming capped

whatsNew.title: Calmer lantern charge
steps: Charge the ring at the lantern in first person
No light shafts across your view
The world dims, but no longer goes black

updates.title: Red battery shines like a diamond block under the patched pack

whatsNew.title: Red battery shines like diamond
steps: Red ring and Red battery in your off hand
Patched Complementary pack on
The crimson stone now gleams like a diamond block

updates.title: What's New book that ticks itself, and review-site pass names in the Ring Lab

whatsNew.title: This book
steps: Ticks itself when you try each entry
Mark done for the ones it can't see
New copy: K > Updates > Get the What's New book

whatsNew.title: Softer glow under shaders, L3 core swirl
steps: With your shader pack on, build constructs and punch
Glow no longer washes the screen green
Charge at the lantern: only the core swirls

whatsNew.title: Punches in first person
steps: Ring in hand or worn, on foot
Left-click: the ring fist jabs, the free fist guards
P1c hook: K > Combat > Punch

whatsNew.title: Flying flurry in first person
steps: V, fly with a charged ring
Left-click a mob: jab, cross, backfist
Arm size: K > Combat > First-person punch and flurry arms

whatsNew.title: Pass names in the Ring Lab
steps: K > any tab
Takes read like the review site: Pass 836 · H3 Braid

whatsNew.title: Ultimate dome
steps: Green lantern: crouch + R to summon it
Look up (45° or more)
Hold R: a 150-block dome

whatsNew.title: Omega beams chain from mob to mob
steps: Charged ring on you
Aim at a group of mobs, hold X
K > Beams > Omega beams: chain

whatsNew.title: Punch, blast and wall poses
steps: Ring in hand or worn, on foot
Left-click: P1b jab (P1c hook in K > Combat > Punch)
Blast and Wall show their poses too

whatsNew.title: Dash strike
whatsNew.pass: Pass 505 · R3a-3 Dash strike, flying ring fist
steps: Charged ring, on foot
Left-click a mob 4.5 to 6.5 blocks away

whatsNew.title: Army construct pig
steps: G > Army
Hold right-click, left-click until Pig
Let go: it rams hostiles
P3 weave: K > Looks > Construct pig

whatsNew.title: Light rays from constructs
steps: Build a Wall, Dome or Bridge
Look for shafts and dust in the light
K > Looks > Construct light rays

whatsNew.title: Lances and flowing ring beams
steps: K > Beams > Beam look: L1, L2 (pass 834) or T2-T6 (pass 830)
G > Beam, then right-click

whatsNew.title: Eight test lasers
steps: K > Beams > Beam look
Pick H3, N1, N2, N3, P1, C1, C2 or C3
G > Beam, then right-click

whatsNew.title: Lasso bubble controls
steps: G > Lasso
Hold right-click on a mob to catch it
Scroll to reel out or in
Swing and let go to throw

whatsNew.title: Lantern charge light
steps: Lantern of your ring's colour: crouch + R
Hold right-click with the ring to charge
Watch the core swirl in the glass

whatsNew.title: Constructs shatter when hit
steps: Ring in hand or worn
Left-click a Wall, Dome or Bridge block

whatsNew.title: Outline flash on hurt mobs
steps: Hurt a mob with a punch or any ring power

whatsNew.title: Double-tap landing, 0.3 carry
steps: Fly within 5 blocks of the ground
Double-tap jump
Also works flying forward: brake, drop in

whatsNew.title: Ring arm leads the flight
steps: Fly and turn: the ring arm leads
D3 adds a bank: K > Flight > Ring arm leads

whatsNew.title: Running dart take-off
whatsNew.pass: Pass 403 · R3A2 Dart, arm a little forward
steps: V, then run
Jump, then jump again in the air
A1 arm at the side: K > Move > Take-off: free arm

whatsNew.title: Ring slot
steps: E: put the ring in the slot above the off hand
It stays on your right hand
An empty hand works as the ring

whatsNew.title: Tools mode
steps: Green or Blue ring > G > Tools
Right-click: six tools in the hotbar
Mine or fight with them; right-click again to put away

whatsNew.title: Shift hyper speed
steps: V, then sprint-fly forward
Hold shift: sonic boom

whatsNew.title: Primed flight slam
steps: In hyper speed (shift)
Look 40° down and dive into the ground
Left-click the crater within 3 s to rebuild

whatsNew.title: Primed super-jump slam
steps: Flight off: sprint about 0.75 s, jump
Crouch on the way down (or hold left-click)

whatsNew.title: Lined slide trench
steps: Flight off: sprint, super jump
Land fast without priming: the slide leaves a lined trench

whatsNew.title: Set the lantern down
whatsNew.pass: Pass 519 · K3c Kneel, pick the lantern up
steps: Lantern in the off hand
Crouch + hold right-click on a block
Stands one block tall; in-hand size: K > Lantern > Set-down lantern size

whatsNew.title: Hip carry and first-person kneel
steps: K > Lantern > Charge style: Hip carry or K3c kneel
Charge the ring and watch in first person

whatsNew.title: Ring Lab keeps your picks
steps: K: change any row; new jars never undo it
★ new on a row = a newer pick to try
✎ adds a note; Updates tab saves a profile

whatsNew.title: Construct hammer swing
steps: G > Hammer
Tap right-click: overhead swing
Tap at a wall: R2b side swing

whatsNew.title: Omega beams
steps: Charged ring on you
Aim and hold X
Several mobs: barrage; works under water

whatsNew.title: Rings R19d, R12b, R12c, R16a
steps: K > Ring > Ring model
Step to R19d, R12b, R12c or R16a

whatsNew.title: Square emblem rings
steps: K > Ring > Ring model
N04 is the ★ pick; also P03 and N01

whatsNew.title: Double-jump take-off
steps: V (flight on), stand still
Jump, then jump again in the air

whatsNew.title: Super jump into ground flight
steps: V on, sprint until the jump arms
Jump, then double-tap jump while sprinting

whatsNew.title: Big flight slam
whatsNew.pass: Pass 510 · S3 H5 S3 M3 slam, 5 blocks
steps: V, sprint-fly fast
Dive 40° down into the ground
Height: K > Combat > Flight slam

whatsNew.title: Flying flurry
steps: V, fly with a charged ring
Left-click a mob

whatsNew.title: Absorb and return blast
whatsNew.pass: Pass 519 · R4b Absorb and fire back
steps: Ring in hand or worn
Hold left-click while a skeleton shoots you
Let go to fire it back

whatsNew.title: Power landing
whatsNew.pass: Pass 519 · D0 Power landing, stop dead
steps: Flight off: sprint, super jump, don't prime
Slow: stop dead; fast: A3 dissolve
B2 plough: K > Move > Power landing slide

whatsNew.title: Ring Lab tabs and search
steps: K: tabs along the top, type to search
Tab and arrow keys move; Copy report

whatsNew.title: Charge: lean in or kneel
whatsNew.pass: Pass 601 · C6a L1c charge, C6a timing
steps: K > Lantern > Charge style: L1c lean or K3c kneel
Lantern out (crouch + R), hold right-click with the ring

whatsNew.title: Ground flight and sonic boom
steps: V, sprint, look 25° down
Double-tap jump: skim the ground
Go fast for the sonic boom; trail: K > Flight > Flight trail

whatsNew.title: Saw mode
steps: Green ring > G > Saw
Hold right-click on a block, drag along the ground
Hold left-click too to cut a trench

whatsNew.title: Nebula lantern light
steps: K > Lantern > Lantern model: Nebula
Nebula light: L1 Column or L4 Core & cage

whatsNew.title: Black hole: spreading eat, final bang
steps: Green ring > G > Black Hole
Hold right-click to aim, left-click for size
Let go and wait for the bang

whatsNew.title: Blast drills
steps: G > Blast, hold right-click (left-click: level)
Let go: the drill bores in
Drill model: K > Combat; barrier T1-T9: K > Looks

whatsNew.title: Hope sanctuary
steps: Place a Blue lantern near animals or villagers
Crouch + right-click it with a ring
The squad domes them, a sanctuary forms above

whatsNew.title: Super jump and sprint
steps: Flight off, charged ring: sprint about 0.75 s
Jump: low forward arc, WASD steers
Prime in the air: crater + dome landing

whatsNew.title: Hammer leap and smash
steps: G > Hammer
Hold right-click to aim the landing ring
Let go to leap and smash

whatsNew.title: Ram barrier
steps: V, sprint-fly fast for about 2 s
Fly into a wall or another barrier

whatsNew.title: Bridge
steps: Green or Blue ring > G > Bridge
Hold right-click to pick a level
Hold left-click too to build; space up, crouch down

whatsNew.title: Wall: pin and drag
steps: G > Wall
Hold right-click to pin it, drag 3x3 to 17x17
Let go

whatsNew.title: Green Deluge
steps: G > Deluge
Hold right-click, let go: glowing hard-light flood

whatsNew.title: Red battery and bloodfire
steps: Get a Red lantern and ring
K > Corps > Red constructs and Red lantern

whatsNew.title: Blue rescue squad
steps: Place a Blue lantern
Crouch + right-click it with any ring

whatsNew.title: Red rage
steps: Get hurt by a Red Lantern: a red-ring mob,
a Rage Bull or a player with a Red ring

whatsNew.title: Orange horde
steps: Orange lantern: crouch + R
Hold R

whatsNew.title: Red self-destruct
steps: Red lantern: crouch + R, hold R
You die and lanterns within 15 blocks break

whatsNew.title: Fear Nuke
steps: Yellow ring > G > Aerial Drop
Hold right-click until it's built in the sky
Let go (costs 75-90%)

whatsNew.title: Dread Runner
steps: Yellow ring > G > Blast
Hold right-click, left-click to level 4
Let go

updates.title: Tone down glow under shader packs; lantern charge shows the L3 core swirl
First person: punches (P1b jab, P1c hook) and the flying flurry F2
Ultimate dome (J's D1 pick, Blender pass 835)
Optimize jar assets after the review keeps
Movement keeps: L4 landing with 0.3 blocks of carry, drop L5/L6, D2 and A3 (#335)
updates.detail:
double-tap landing is L4 with its forward travel scaled by 0.375 (0.3 blocks, 0.30 s),
arm lead keeps D1 (default) and D3, the running dart's free arm keeps A2 (default) and A1.
A saved L5/L6/D2/A3 loads as the row's pick and the Copy report lists the reset.

Construct tools draw on the worn ring too
